answers.rationale: The requirement specifies a 15kV metal-clad switchgear lineup. The CROWN-ARMV product is a metal-clad MV switchgear lineup that supports 15kV and is arc-resistant, which aligns with the specification.
Protective relays and controls are specified. The EP2-RPP product provides protective relays and relay panels, which are suitable for this requirement.
The detailed specification of the switchgear, including breaker positions, meters, isolation switches, and CTs, matches the capabilities of the CROWN-ARMV product.
The requirement for arc-resistant Type 2B switchgear per IEEE C37.20.7 is directly met by the CROWN-ARMV product, which is designed to meet these standards.
The equipment building is specified to be provided by others, so this is not a product requirement.

A separate utility cable termination compartment with locking capability is required. The CROWN-ACC product includes accessories for MV switchgear, such as cable termination compartments, which meet this requirement.
The requirement for each phase to have a 1-inch diameter ground ball can be met with the CROWN-ACC product, which includes ground balls as part of its accessories for MV switchgear.
